chunks.prompt: Black screen displays Creative Commons license information.
在 Ocean，蓝色波浪水面上浮现文字 'Your Name Here presents'。 (Music starts.)
在 Ocean 中，文字显示 'in association with Your Money'。 (Music continues.)
Sita 从 Ocean 水面升起，黑卷发垂落，头戴金饰，身披粉衣，双手持物，全身显现于 Lotus Flower 之上。 (Music continues.)
In Ocean, Ornate gramophone rises on lotus next to Sita. (Music continues.)
Sita dances gracefully on a pink lotus flower in the ocean, as the ornate gramophone with peacock feather horn plays a record. (Singing begins.)
Sita stands on a pink lotus flower in the ocean, beside an ornate gramophone with a peacock feather horn. (Singing continues.)
Particle explosion reveals 'Sita Sings the Blues' title. (Singing continues.)
Credits show 'a film by Nina Paley'. (Singing continues.)
Shadow Narrator, a black silhouette adorned with white patterns, sits cross-legged on a lotus, holding a pink lotus flower as glowing particles swirl around. (Singing continues.)
Blue Vishnu lies on serpent, Sita massages feet. (Singing continues.)
Rama sits atop the lotus flower. Shadow Narrator speaks beside him. (Singing continues.)
Sita的心跳可见，Shadow Narrator旁述月神战车显现。 (Singing continues.)
Shadow Narrator gestures beside a pink lotus flower. (Singing continues.)
Shadow Narrator 俯瞰大地，镜头推近大陆轮廓。 (Singing continues.)
In Ocean, Earth fills screen, transitions to solid blue. (Singing continues.)

Text 'SAN FRANCISCO' over animation of a modern cityscape featuring the iconic Golden Gate Bridge spanning a bay, with skyscrapers, waterfront piers, and a bustling urban skyline under a clear sky. (Singing continues.)
Modern Woman and Modern Man are sleeping in the Bedroom, with a beige striped Cat, its white belly visible, curled at their foot. (Singing continues.)
In Bedroom, Cat wakes up, yawns, stretches. (Singing continues.)
In the Kitchen, Cat walks to Cat Food Bowl and meows, surrounded by dark cabinets that frame the modern space. (Cat meow.)
In Bedroom, Cat jumps on bed and yells at Modern Woman, waking her. (Cat yell.)
Modern Woman feeds the Cat in the Kitchen, and the Cat eats from the Cat Food Bowl. (Singing continues.)
Modern Woman 和 Modern Man 在 Bedroom 的床上亲吻后入睡，Cat 在旁。 (Singing continues.)
Modern Woman 和 Modern Man 在 Living Room 的绿色沙发上睡觉，Cat 走到 Kitchen 并靠近 Cat Food Bowl。 (Singing continues.)
在Living Room中，Modern Woman 转身无视 Modern Man，Cat 站在床边。 (Singing continues.)
Shadow Narrator 旁白描述现代女人在厨房给猫喂食，猫从柜子跳下吃碗里猫粮。 (Singing continues.)
Shadow Narrator 旁观 Modern Man 和 Modern Woman 在卧室拥抱，Cat 在附近走动。 (Singing continues.)
Shadow Narrator appears as a black silhouette with white patterns, narrating the Ramayana story. (Singing continues.)
Rama and the Shadow Narrator appear together. (Singing continues.)
Sita被介绍为Rama的 bride，由Shadow Narrator说明。 (Singing continues.)
In Ayodhya Palace, Dasharatha crowns Rama, Kaikeyi objects. (Singing continues.)
In Ayodhya Palace, Kaikeyi demands exile, king collapses. (Singing continues.)
In Ayodhya Palace, King dies, Bharat refuses throne, Rama exiled. (Singing continues.)
Rama, Sita, and Shadow Narrator prepare for forest. (Singing continues.)

Sita and Rama walk through a dense green forest, its canopy thick with leafy branches filtering sunlight, undergrowth carpeted with wildflowers in hues of pink and yellow, while the Shadow Narrator gestures toward the d? (Singing continues.)
Sita and Rama stand in the Forest, surrounded by Shadow Narrator. (Singing continues.)
In Forest, Rama fights purple one-eyed demons. (Singing continues.)
在Forest中，Rama 在森林中与恶魔战斗后拥抱 Sita，Shadow Narrator 旁白。 (Singing continues.)
Rama 和 Sita 在 Forest 中跳舞，周围是被击败的 demons，Shadow Narrator 旁白。 (Singing continues.)
Modern Woman and Modern Man embrace in San Francisco airport crowd. (Singing continues.)
In San Francisco, Couple kisses, man leaves with luggage. (Singing continues.)
Ravana, ten-headed demon with green-gold skin and multiple arms, gestures while Shadow Narrator appears beside him. (Singing continues.)
Rama 被击败倒在地上，Ravana 站在他上方，Shadow Narrator 向他示意。 (Singing continues.)
Ravana gestures toward Sita while Shadow Narrator observes. (Singing continues.)
Ravana transforms into a glowing golden deer adorned with intricate patterns, while Shadow Narrator gestures toward him. (Singing continues.)
In Forest, Sita spots Golden Deer, asks Rama to catch it. (Singing continues.)
在Forest中，Rama在森林中持弓箭追逐金色鹿，Ravana悄然靠近茅屋，Sita在旁。 (Singing continues.)
In the Forest, Ravana grabs Sita, causing her to drop jewelry. (Singing continues.)
Ravana carries Sita toward Lanka Castle, its purple towers gleaming gold under the twilight sky. (Singing continues.)
在Forest中，Rama在森林中返回，发现Sita失踪，遇见Hanuman——这位紫灰皮肤、头戴金冠的猴王，Shadow Narrator旁白叙述。 (Singing continues.)
Hanuman 跨越森林飞跃而过，向 Rama 承诺援助，Shadow Narrator 旁白提及 Ocean。 (Singing continues.)
在森林中，蓝肤的Rama从树后现身，与身着粉色纱丽的Sita相拥，Hanuman在旁注视，Ravana立于Lanka Castle高处俯瞰。 (Singing continues.)
Hanuman 与 Sita 在 Lanka Castle 的森林中站立交谈，Shadow Narrator 在旁。 (Singing continues.)
在 Lanka Castle，Ravana 的恶魔们点燃了 Hanuman 的尾巴，Hanuman 随之变大。 (Singing continues.)
Hanuman用燃烧的尾巴点燃了Lanka Castle，Ravana在旁目睹。 (Singing continues.)
Hanuman 跨过 Ocean 跳回 Rama 旁，Shadow Narrator 旁白。 (Singing continues.)
In Bedroom, Modern Woman wakes to phone call from Modern Man. (Phone ringtone.)
Modern Woman 在 Bedroom 与 Modern Man 争吵，Modern Woman 哭泣。 (Dialogue/arguing sounds.)
Modern Man hangs up in Bedroom while Modern Woman sobs in bed; Cat is present. (Sobbing sounds.)
在Lanka Castle，Sita拒绝了Ravana的示好。 (Singing continues.)
在 Lanka Castle，Ravana 与 Sita 在人群中相拥后分离，她独自前行。 (Singing continues.)
在 Lanka Castle，Sita 在树下冥想，思绪牵动 Ravana。 (Singing continues.)
在 Lanka Castle，Hanuman 向 Sita 保证 Rama 即将抵达。 (Singing continues.)
Rama and Hanuman stand on ocean shore, shadow narrator gestures beside them. (Singing continues.)
Rama带领Hanuman率领的猴军穿过已完成的Lanka Castle桥梁，Shadow Narrator在旁叙述。 (Singing continues.)
Rama和Hanuman在Lanka Castle门前与Ravana对峙，Shadow Narrator在一旁旁白。 (Singing continues.)
Rama in Lanka Castle shoots arrows with his bow and arrow; Ravana deflects them. (Singing continues.)
在 Lanka Castle，Rama 用弓箭射杀 Ravana，Sita 被解救，恶魔四散逃窜。 (Singing continues.)
Modern Woman packs suitcase in bedroom. (Singing continues.)
Modern Woman watches an animated map showing a flight from San Francisco to Trivandrum, India. (Singing continues.)
Sita 站立优雅地手持莲花，Rama 在她身旁观察，Shadow Narrator 旁白。 (Singing continues.)
Sita stands before Rama, who accepts her return, as Shadow Narrator observes. (Singing continues.)
Modern Woman and Modern Man walk through San Francisco streets. (Singing continues.)
In San Francisco, the Modern Woman finds the Modern Man, and they embrace and kiss passionately. (Singing continues.)
在San Francisco中，在旧金山，Modern Man透露自己已婚，Modern Woman神情崩溃。 (Singing continues.)
Sita stands beside Rama in the forest, gesturing toward a glowing golden deer, with Shadow Narrator present. (Singing continues.)

Sita, in pink dress, watches from her hermitage doorway as Rama, in orange dhoti with bow and arrow, chases a glowing golden deer across the Forest, while the Shadow Narrator observes. (Singing continues.)
在Forest中，Rama在森林中拉弓瞄准，Sita站在茅屋旁，Shadow Narrator在旁。 (Singing continues.)
In San Francisco, Modern Woman sits alone in dim hotel room looking out window. (Singing continues.)
Modern Woman lies in bed staring at ceiling in San Francisco, unable to sleep. (Singing continues.)
Modern Woman sits up in San Francisco, looks at the moon through the window, and misses Man. (Singing continues.)
Modern Woman stands in San Francisco, smiling as butterflies flutter around her. (Singing continues.)
Modern Woman shivers and hugs herself tightly for warmth in San Francisco. (Singing continues.)
Modern Woman curls into fetal position on bed in San Francisco, crying silently. (Singing continues.)
Screen fades to black, end credits roll over music. (Music fades out.)
Sita sits under a tree in the Forest, her thought bubble shows Rama and Hanuman. (Singing continues.)
在Forest中，Sita被Ravana的十个头颅幻象惊吓，惊慌逃窜。 (Singing continues.)
Sita hangs from a golden chariot in the Forest, her expression showing despair. (Singing continues.)
In Forest, Sita shakes head, dispelling dark memories, looks determined. (Singing continues.)
In Forest, Shadow Narrator silhouette gestures towards Sita's story. (Narration voiceover.)
Shadow Narrator在Forest中讲述Sita的考验与流放。 (Narration continues.)
In Forest, Shadow Narrator bows, fades into background foliage. (Narration ends.)
在 Lanka Castle 的王座厅，十首魔王 Ravana 与众恶魔庆祝胜利。 (Demonic chanting music.)
Ravana, with ten heads and multiple arms, laughs maniacally in Lanka Castle while waving weapons. (Evil laughter.)
在 Lanka Castle，十首多臂的 Ravana 面对黑影叙述者。 (Marching drums.)
在 Lanka Castle，Ravana 与恶魔们一起磨砺长矛和战斧，备战。 (Metal sharpening sounds.)
Ravana stands on Lanka Castle balcony, gesturing toward distant horizon. (Ravana's booming voice.)
猴王哈努曼在森林中腾跃，与Ravana对峙，Lanka Castle在附近。 (War cries.)
In Lanka Castle, Contrast cut: Sita sitting sadly under tree while demons party. (Sad flute melody.)
在 Lanka Castle，Ravana 的恶魔们向 Sita 投掷鲜花嘲弄她，Sita 不理睬。 (Mocking laughter.)
In Lanka Castle, Sita closes eyes, hands folded in prayer, ignoring chaos. (Prayer chant.)
In Ocean, Hanuman lifts massive boulder effortlessly over head. (Heavy lifting grunts.)
Hanuman 在 Ocean 中与其他猴子手手传递岩石入水。 (Rhythmic work song.)
Hanuman strides across the Ocean toward Lanka Castle. (Splash sounds.)
Rama站在建筑区边缘，指挥着Hanuman，背景是Ocean。 (Command shouts.)
在Ocean中，Rama 和 Hanuman 站在 Lanka Castle 的岸边，桥连接着海洋。 (Cheering monkeys.)
In Ocean, Rama steps onto bridge first, followed by Hanuman. (Footsteps on stone.)
Rama and Hanuman stand together on the ocean surface, facing forward. (Mass movement sound.)
Ravana 在 Lanka Castle 前手持 Bow and Arrow 面对 Sita，Rama 与 Hanuman 在场。 (War horn blast.)
在 Lanka Castle，Ravana 与 Hanuman 交锋，Rama 在旁观战。 (Battle cacophony.)
在 Lanka Castle，Hanuman 用单柄战锤击碎 Ravana 的三只恶魔。 (Crunching impacts.)
In Lanka Castle, Rama fires rapid arrows, each hitting a demon precisely. (Arrow whooshes.)
在 Lanka Castle，Hanuman 与 Ravana 对峙，Ravana 用魔法咒语暂时将部分猴子石化。 (Magic zaps.)
在 Lanka Castle，Hanuman 与 Ravana 对峙，双方激烈交战。 (Roars of effort.)
在 Lanka Castle，Rama 与 Hanuman 一同逼退 Ravana，猴子大军步步紧逼。 (Victory chants rising.)
在 Lanka Castle，Ravana 亲自参战挥舞巨剑，Rama 在场。 (Thunderous footsteps.)
In Lanka Castle, Rama and Ravana lock weapons, sparks fly from impact. (Metal clashing.)
Rama在Lanka Castle手持Bow and Arrow瞄准Ravana的胸膛。 (Humming energy sound.)
在 Lanka Castle，Rama 以慢动作射出 Bow and Arrow，贯穿 Ravana 的心脏。 (Sharp release sound.)
在 Lanka Castle，Ravana 跌跌撞撞，丢下武器，无力倒地。 (Heavy thud.)
Hanuman flies over ocean and forest toward Lanka Castle, where Ravana awaits. (Surrender murmurs.)
Rama rushes through the ruins of Lanka Castle toward Ashoka grove. (Urgent running footsteps.)
In Lanka Castle, Rama finds Sita, they embrace tightly, tears flowing. (Sobbing and relief sighs.)
In Lanka Castle, Hanuman approaches, bows deeply to both Rama and Sita. (Respectful silence.)
在 Lanka Castle，Hanuman 与 Sita 交谈，Rama 旁观。 (Magical hum.)
Rama stands in Ayodhya Palace, surrounded by shadow figures. (Joyous crowd noise.)
Sita and Rama walk through the flower-covered path in Ayodhya Palace. (Music and chants.)
Shadow Narrator 与 Rama 在 Ayodhya Palace 内并肩而立。 (Solemn music.)
在Ayodhya Palace，Priest为Rama戴上金色王冠，Shadow Narrator在旁见证。 (Sacred mantra.)
In Ayodhya Palace, Sita receives jeweled tiara, standing beside Rama. (Cheers erupt.)
Shadow Narrator gestures toward Rama seated on throne in Ayodhya Palace, symbolizing Rama's true rule. (Respectful silence.)
Rama stands in Ayodhya Palace, raising hand to address people. (Rama's voice.)
Modern Woman walks alone at night in San Francisco. (Music shift to melancholy.)
Modern Woman walks down empty Indian street in San Francisco under streetlights. (Distant traffic.)
Modern Woman enters the small hotel lobby in San Francisco and nods tiredly at the receptionist. (Key handover sound.)
Modern Woman dances gracefully in San Francisco, surrounded by purple flowers and ancient towers. (Door creak, bag thud.)
Modern Woman stares out the window at San Francisco city lights, her reflection visible in the glass. (City hum.)
Modern Woman dances gracefully in San Francisco, surrounded by trees and purple flowers. (Silence.)
Modern Woman slowly removes her outer clothes, left in underwear, sits on the bed edge in San Francisco. (Fabric rustle.)
Modern Woman in San Francisco buries her face in her hands, shoulders shaking with silent sobs. (Muffled crying.)
Sita meditates peacefully in the Forest, surrounded by blooming flowers, as the Modern Woman watches. (Dreamy echo.)
In Forest, Sita meditating, aura of golden light surrounds her. (Ethereal hum.)
在Forest中，Sita 周围的花朵在森林中迅速绽放，动物们和平聚集。 (Birdsong.)
Sita opens eyes in the Forest, serene smile, unbothered by past trauma. (Soft exhale.)
In Forest, Light beams from Sita towards viewer (modern woman's POV). (Inspiring chord.)
In San Francisco, Modern Woman gasps awake in bed, tears dried, expression changed. (Sharp intake of breath.)
Modern Woman 在 San Francisco 坐直身体，擦拭面部，凝视镜中，神情坚定。 (Resolve music.)
Modern Woman walks confidently through San Francisco, carrying a suitcase. (Upbeat tempo.)
Modern Woman lies on bed in San Francisco, smiling with eyes closed. (Morning birds.)
Modern Woman sits up with arms crossed, looking concerned, as Modern Man lies on the bed in San Francisco. (Market bustle.)
Modern Woman sits on bed in San Francisco, observing moonlight through window. (Temple bells.)
Modern Woman sits on beach in San Francisco watching sunset, peaceful, not lonely. (Waves crashing.)
Modern Woman在San Francisco挥手致意。 (Cafe ambience.)
Modern Woman 在 San Francisco 的森林中，与蓝肤的 Rama 并肩而立，Rama 手持弓箭。 (Laughter.)
Modern Woman dances joyfully with Rama in San Francisco, arms wide, holding bow and arrow. (Upbeat folk music.)
Modern Woman 站在 San Francisco 的繁花绿树森林中，身旁有蓝皮肤的Rama手持弓箭并立。 (Shutter click.)
Modern Woman stands with Sita in the Forest among flowering trees. (Music swell.)
In the Forest, Sita stands before Rama and shakes her head, refusing the second trial. (Silent refusal.)
In the Forest, Sita rises from the glowing ground. (Earth rumble.)
Sita sinks into the earth in the Forest, smiling peacefully. (Peaceful chime.)
In Forest, Rama watches, tears in eyes, understands her choice. (Sad but respectful music.)
In San Francisco, Modern Woman stands on beach, arms crossed, looking at horizon, content. (Ocean waves.)
Modern Woman stands in San Francisco as the sun sets behind her, silhouette strong and independent. (Music fades.)
Black screen with white text credits rolling upwards. (End theme song.)
